entities.title: Kvarðinn
entities.summary: An Icelandic team guessing game on a 0–100 scale for 4–12 players, each on their own phone or laptop, joined from one shared link with only a name.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the rules in src/engine/, the page in src/client/ and public/, the scale cards in data/kvardar.txt, the Worker and its room Durable Object in worker/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: No sign-in: unlike the other games it does not use vendor/icelander-auth (decisions.json, no-sign-in).
Rooms are its own Durable Object, not the games hub's relay (decisions.json, authoritative-room).
No database: each room's game lives in its Durable Object's storage and is deleted after two idle days.
